chapter: Shows, scripts and the Mosby-era names
title: The Bug Opera and the trial of Mr. Jitterbug
summary: Clarence Muse suggested something like Trilby, so Spikes wrote a bug concert in which Mr. Jitterbug is tried for beating up the Two-Step and the Waltz.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: I was telling you about that, that Clarence had these producers over there and men with money, but he didn't have no script or no music or nothing. He was just...he was talkin', tryin' to get something, you see. And when I went over and told him about the music and things I had, then he come over and said, "Well, I ain't got no book or nothing. What are you gonna do?" And he said, "Can't you write something?" And I said, "I guess so. I don't know." And he said, "Why'n't you write something like 'Trilby'?" You know what "Trilby" is? Crazy magician or something, you know, and he ...and I said, "Well, how's it go?" And he told me about it, so I had one in there. I wrote "The Bugs" for that and everything, and I had it in there as a bug concert, you see. We had the whole town little bugs. That was the name of it...uh, uh...where the...one of the bugs was Jitterbug--Mr. Jitterbug--and the songs and everything portr...was a opera, see? And I had in there where they arrested the Jitterbug because he'd kicked the hell outa the Two-Step, and he beat up the Waltz and he was ruinin' the country--the bug country. So they had his trial, and they brought him in, and they put him on the stand, and they had a witness and everything, and they gave him hell for...for...for beatin' up these people, and he's kickin' the hell outa the Two-Step and the Waltz, and the One-Step and ever'thing. He'd killed all...he'd killed nearly...some of 'em he'd killed and others he had all crippled. We brought 'em in, and the Two-Step was crippled with a cane, and the Waltz was on crutches and things, and...but they was all bugs, y'see, and it was...it was quite a sens...That would be good now--"The Bug Opera"-- you know, but the King Bug was the Jitterbug. He was the one that was causin' all the trouble, and we held court on him. The other was court--trying him. And it was funny.
